correctness.rationale: A fixed boundary ear in a uniform n-gon triangulation has probability p=C_(n-3)/C_(n-2)=(n-1)/(2(2n-5)), adjacent ears cannot coexist, and each nonadjacent pair has probability q=C_(n-4)/C_(n-2)=(n-1)(n-2)/(4(2n-7)(2n-5)). Consequently K=(p-q)I-qA_cycle+(q-p²)J, giving constant lambda0=(n-5)(n-4)(n-1)/(2(2n-7)(2n-5)²), and nonconstant lambda_j=p-q-2q cos(2pi j/n). Lambda0 vanishes only at n=5. Compare lambda_1-lambda0 and bound cos by exact rational inequalities for all 5<=n<=20 (each checked by script), then a positive-coefficient cubic after n=21 for the reverse sign. These prove the only switch between n=20 and 21. Max mode nearest pi, and n6 yields lambda_min=1/49, max=1/2 so ratio=49/2; rational monotonic bounds cover all other n and limit 5. Independently recomputed p,q and sample spectra n=5,6,7,20,21,22,100,1000, and inspected full check.py and RESULT.md. Finite tests were not used to establish unbounded-size bounds.
